# Response to RFQ VPK-2026-014 — Technical maintenance, warehouse and logistics properties

Visakoivu Oy

## Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA qualification, valid to 2027-03-31. Turnover for the most recent financial year was EUR 20,300,000, against the EUR 5,000,000 threshold in Section 3.4.

## Technical response

**Occupational safety plan.** A site-specific occupational safety plan is enclosed, maintained under our NMSB 75310:2018 system (valid to 2026-11-30), addressing the hazards specific to each of the three sites.

**Condition-monitoring data.** Measurements taken at each visit are logged and reported to the buyer in a standard visit report, covering all monitored systems at that site.

**Environmental matters.** Managed under our NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management system (valid to 2027-06-30), covering waste segregation, hazardous-substance handling and spill prevention.

**Quality control and testing.** Delivered under our NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system (valid to 2027-06-30), with each visit checked against a standard work instruction.

**Preventive maintenance plan.** A preventive maintenance plan is proposed for the systems covered by this contract, sequencing servicing ahead of known wear points.

**HVAC maintenance agreement.** Our proposed HVAC maintenance agreement covers scheduled inspection, cleaning and performance checks across all three sites, with scope set out per site.

**Personnel qualifications.** Personnel working on site hold the occupational cards and trade certificates the work requires, and are briefed on site-specific procedures before starting work.

**Building automation compatibility.** Compatible with BACnet/Modbus building automation systems, allowing direct integration with the buyer's existing platform.

**Routine maintenance visits.** A fixed visit calendar is proposed for all three sites, with content and scheduling confirmed with the site contact in advance.

**Service-level targets.** SLA targets are proposed for each site, covering both response time and completion time.

## Commercial terms

The proposed contract period follows Section 1, with the extension option accepted. Our proposed limitation-of-liability clause reflects our professional indemnity cover of EUR 1,000,000. A bonus/malus arrangement is proposed against the service levels above.

## Forms enclosed

List of subcontractors (Liite 3); completed Reference Form (Liite 2).

## Format

Font size throughout is 11pt or larger. Reference currency is EUR. This document does not exceed 20 pages excluding appendices. Unit basis for pricing is per property. Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year, not on a monthly basis, as required under Section 7.5.

## Annex A — Technical specification

Lift maintenance is carried out in accordance with the applicable regulatory inspection requirements. Fault reports outside normal working hours are covered by our standby (on-call) arrangement, with a defined response-time commitment. Faults remaining unresolved after the initial response are escalated to our senior technical staff on a defined timescale.

## Annex B — Forms and commercial terms

A current trade register extract is enclosed. Completed Tender Form (Liite 1).

Visakoivu Oy
